title: Fleet Signalboard: Snapshot & Audit Trail for Dedicated Capacity Controls
creator: Riya Patel
description: Ship a unified Fleet Signalboard in the Console that combines scaling controls, a time-windowed throughput snapshot, and an immutable change audit trail. The goal is to give operators one surface to: (1) adjust autoscale and min/max capacity knobs with immediate preview of downstream effects, (2) inspect historical throughput and allocation snapshots across tenant pools, and (3) review and export an auditable change history for compliance and postmortems.
acceptance_criteria: UI surface exposes per-fleet scaling knobs (min, max, preferred-concurrency) and a preview that simulates 1/5/15-minute throughput impact
Throughput snapshot displays P50/P95/P99 latency and tokens/sec per tenant pool for selected time windows and allows zoom to 1-minute granularity
Change history stores immutable record of operator actions (who, when, before/after) and supports CSV export and link-to-PR/Runbook
Server-side APIs for preview and snapshot obey RBAC and return results within 300ms for cached windows
Feature gated behind beta flag and available to Dedicated customers in staging before GA rollout

decisions: Use heuristic preview model for initial launch to avoid heavy simulation compute; accurate within +/-15% for steady workloads
Snapshot retention: 90 days of 1-minute rollups in hot store, 13 months of daily aggregates in cold storage
Audit trail records immutable JSON lines in an append-only store; CSV export provided by backend job
Beta release limited to Dedicated customers with admin role; RBAC enforced at API and UI layers
prs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3314 — feature: signalboard UI components and preview panel
rollout_plan: Week 1: Internal QA and e2e tests with synthetic workloads
Week 2: Soft launch to 3 Dedicated pilot customers behind feature flag
Week 3: Iterate on UX + add cost-delta estimates (if feasible)
Week 4: Gradual ramp to all Dedicated customers; monitor errors and rollback if error rate > 0.5%
testing_plan: Unit tests for preview API heuristics with controlled traces
Load test snapshot endpoints with 500 concurrent requests to validate 300ms SLO
Manual QA: verify audit trail entries match UI actions and exported CSVs
Security test: ensure audit entries do not leak full operator tokens
notes: Trade-offs: accurate simulation engine would improve predictions but add CPU cost. We prioritized speed and ROI for first release.
Follow-ups: integrate cost model and per-tenant recommendations in Q3; add provider-aware knobs (gpu pool vs cpu pool) in next phase.
Related initiatives: Capacity Intent Editor (PM-42109) and Dedicated autoscale runtime heuristics (ENG-22098).
